title.zh: 【MetaMask 将 Stellar 设为默认网络，存量账户自动获得 Stellar 地址】
title.en: 【MetaMask 将 Stellar 设为默认网络，存量账户自动获得 Stellar 地址】

current_state.zh: MetaMask partnered with the Stellar Development Foundation to make Stellar a default network in its mobile and browser-extension wallets, automatically deriving Stellar addresses from existing users' mnemonics and allowing existing Stellar users to import their seed phrases.
current_state.en: MetaMask partnered with the Stellar Development Foundation to make Stellar a default network in its mobile and browser-extension wallets, automatically deriving Stellar addresses from existing users' mnemonics and allowing existing Stellar users to import their seed phrases.

updates.title_zh: 【MetaMask 将 Stellar 设为默认网络，存量账户自动获得 Stellar 地址】
updates.title_en: 【MetaMask 将 Stellar 设为默认网络，存量账户自动获得 Stellar 地址】
updates.what_changed_zh:
MetaMask 宣布与 Stellar 发展基金会达成合作，将 Stellar 设为其移动端与浏览器插件端钱包的默认网络，集成已于公告发布当日上线。所有存量 MetaMask 账户将基于用户已有的助记词自动派生出 Stellar 地址，无需额外设置，已有 Stellar 用户也可导入原有助记词进行迁移。

MetaMask 首席产品官 Gal Eldar 在公告中将此次集成定位为其「Open Money」战略的一部分，称目标是让同一套支付基础设施惠及所有用户。将 Stellar 设为默认网络，省去了此前在 MetaMask 中使用非 EVM 链通常需要手动添加网络的步骤。

Stellar 地址由用户已有助记词确定性派生，而非要求新建助记词，且该变更同时覆盖移动端与插件端。公告未披露此次集成的链上交易量目标。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: MetaMask partnered with the Stellar Development Foundation to make Stellar a default network in its mobile and browser-extension wallets, automatically deriving Stellar addresses from existing users' mnemonics and allowing existing Stellar users to import their seed phrases.
updates.detailed_summary_en: MetaMask partnered with the Stellar Development Foundation to make Stellar a default network in its mobile and browser-extension wallets, automatically deriving Stellar addresses from existing users' mnemonics and allowing existing Stellar users to import their seed phrases.
updates.background_zh: MetaMask 是以太坊虚拟机（EVM）生态为主的自托管钱包，默认网络为以太坊，其他 EVM 链需手动添加，非 EVM 链此前通常通过 Snaps 或自定义配置接入。Stellar 是一条开源区块链，针对快速、低成本转账与跨境支付进行优化，并通过锚点（anchors）连接法币体系。
updates.background_en: MetaMask is an EVM-centric self-custody wallet that defaults to Ethereum, with additional EVM chains added manually and non-EVM chains historically accessed through Snaps or custom configuration. Stellar is an open-source blockchain optimized for fast, low-cost transfers and cross-border payments, connecting to fiat systems through anchors.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径来自分发渠道而非协议本身：Stellar 的支付与跨境汇款场景，以及 XLM 和该网络上发行的资产，在用户基数最大的 EVM 自托管钱包中获得直接入口，可能影响用户入金路径与钱包层面的可达性。该集成不改变 Stellar 的供应量、共识机制或结算规则。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through distribution rather than protocol: Stellar's payments and remittance corridors, along with XLM and assets issued on the network, gain a direct entry point in the most widely used EVM self-custody wallet, which could affect user onboarding flows and wallet-level access. It does not alter Stellar's supply, consensus, or settlement mechanics.
